course_id: Hệ thống thương mại điện tử
title: System of Electronic Commerce

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of electronic commerce including benefits, platforms, models, applications, infrastructure, payment systems, transaction security, legal frameworks, and solutions for businesses.
Comprehend relevant legal frameworks related to electronic commerce in Vietnam.
Gain knowledge on technologies supporting electronic commerce models.
Learn to use WordPress as a platform for electronic commerce systems.
